trigger: host with a release-less OpenJDK 8 home (Ubuntu 22.04, Rocky 9, Alpine) beside healthy homes

Derived LOW (I8): rows are kept, not deleted; routed clause 2 requires the token. Reporter labelled MEDIUM; derived band governs (disagreement recorded).
classification_rationale: behaviour matches routed clause 2; observability gap is pre-existing for every token
